origin: Explicit user request to actually verify the final hidden-RGB hypothesis and close the curation round.
reviewed_by: Codex same-agent technical and actual-image review
archival: Original candidate bytes retained through candidate-archives index; earlier partial review and all historical restrictions remain.
adopted: Conditional alpha==0 RGB cleanup on derived straight-alpha 8-bit assets; preserve every alpha>0 pixel, crop placement and actual alpha-aware consumer/transform verification.
counterexamples: Pillow RGB conversion/OpenCV color-only read expose hidden original pixels. Cleanup alone is not correct flattening.
Straight-channel resize/rotate can change edge colors after cleanup; use tested premultiplied filtering and actual output comparison.
Low-alpha <=8 removal visibly changes real soft edges.
Tight bounding crop does not repair a wrong matte; preserve original origin.
not_adopted: Unconditional sanitization of production inputs, low-alpha thresholding, inferred foreground segmentation, universal format/app compatibility, any new whole-video or native-language acceptance.

implementation.mode: opt-in derived copy; no production route rewired

round_closure.boundary: New records generated by ongoing production since the frozen review snapshot remain a separate batch. This closure does not approve/archive them.
